title: Creamy Tuscan Garlic Butter Chicken
ingredients: 2 boneless chicken breasts, sliced into cutlets
1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes, drained and sliced
2 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter
Salt, freshly cracked pepper, and dried oregano
steps: Season chicken cutlets on both sides with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown, then set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté minced garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in chicken stock and heavy cream, bringing the sauce to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in spinach and parmesan until cheese is melted and spinach is wilted.
Return chicken to the skillet, spoon creamy sauce over, and simmer for another 2 minutes before serving.
author: Chef Subash

title: Authentic Neapolitan Margherita Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 cup San Marzano crushed tomato sauce
Handful of fresh sweet basil leaves
steps: Preheat oven with baking steel/stone to maximum temperature (250°C / 480°F).
Gently stretch dough on a lightly floured board, pressing out from center to create a puffy crust edge.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over the surface, leaving crust border clean.
Tear fresh mozzarella over sauce and drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.
Bake for 7-9 minutes until crust edges blister and cheese is bubbling.
Top immediately with fresh aromatic basil leaves and serve hot.
author: Maria Rossi

title: Spicy Thai Holy Basil Fried Rice
ingredients: 250g minced chicken breast or pressed tofu
1.5 tbsp dark soy sauce & 1 tbsp fish sauce
steps: Crush garlic and bird's eye chilies together in a mortar to release natural oils.
Heat wok on high with oil; fry chili-garlic paste for 20 seconds until intensely aromatic.
Add minced chicken, stirring rapidly to break into bite-sized morsels until thoroughly cooked.
Add sauces followed by chilled jasmine rice, stir-frying on highest heat for 2 minutes.
Turn off flame, toss in holy basil until wilted, and top with a crispy wok-fried egg.
author: Chef Somchai

title: Classic Roman Carbonara
ingredients: 3 large fresh egg yolks + 1 whole egg
Plenty of freshly cracked coarse black pepper
Sea salt for boiling pasta water
steps: Bring water to a boil with moderate salt; cook pasta until al dente.
In a bowl, vigorously whisk egg yolks, whole egg, and pecorino cheese with cracked black pepper until thick.
In a deep pan, slowly render guanciale on medium heat until crisp and amber; remove pan from heat.
Transfer pasta directly into the pan with guanciale fat, tossing to coat thoroughly.
Allow pan to cool for 20 seconds, then pour egg-cheese mixture with 3 tbsp pasta water.
Vigorously stir until a glossy, velvety emulsion coats every strand of pasta. Serve immediately!
author: Chef Antonio

title: Japanese Fluffy Soufflé Pancakes
ingredients: 2 eggs, separated into yolks and whites
2 tbsp milk & 1 tsp pure vanilla extract
Butter and pure maple syrup for serving
steps: Whisk yolks with milk and vanilla; sift in flour and baking powder and mix until smooth.
Whip egg whites while gradually adding sugar until stiff glossy peaks form.
Gently fold meringue into yolk batter in two additions, keeping the mixture airy.
Scoop tall towers of batter onto a lidded non-stick skillet on very low heat.
Add a splash of water, cover, and steam 4 minutes per side.
Serve hot with a pat of butter, warm maple syrup, and fresh berries.
author: Yuki Tanaka

title: Avocado & Poached Egg Artisan Toast
ingredients: 1 ripe Hass avocado, pitted and mashed
Red chili flakes & flaky Maldon sea salt
steps: Toast sourdough bread slices until golden brown and crispy.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Poach eggs in gently simmering water for 3 minutes until whites set and yolk stays runny.
Generously spread avocado over toast and top each with a warm poached egg.
Sprinkle with flaky sea salt, red chili flakes, and microgreens.
author: Emma Watson
